notify.h_stall_released.back: At first the system thought it was a sales / fraud call, but on the second check it found it was a normal call, so the AI went back to talking as normal

notify.h_stall_spam_nokind.back: The system judged this to be a sales / fraud call, so the AI deliberately kept talking to stall the caller

notify.s_ai_fail_prefix.back: [The AI could not connect. The system hung up]

call.speech.think_about_it.back: Let me think about this first.
call.speech.think_about_it.note: fixed: removed female-only particle, now gender-neutral. Uses the female-only particle คะ although the owner's sex is unknown; it should be gender-neutral wording (or follow an owner setting).

call.speech.wait_one_more.back: Oh, wait, let me ask one more question.

names.aliases.back: Thai language, thai, thailand, phasa thai, siamese

app.about_dedicated.back: In AI mode, the module takes control of the phone app, turns off the ringtone and turns on Do Not Disturb, so it suits a spare device. If you want to use the phone normally for a while, turn off the switch at the top.

app.about_legal.back: Laws on recording calls and on telling the caller they are talking to an AI vary by area. You are responsible for complying.

app.about_rollback.back: To remove Bageo completely, first turn off the switch at the top (back to a normal phone), then turn off or delete the module in Magisk or KernelSU and restart the device.

app.agent_url_label.note: Source says 'Agent address'; written as 'connection address' because 'agent' is not a user-facing word (UI_TEXT_RULES §5)

app.btn_console.back: Open the control page on the web

app.btn_reset_usb.note: Resets the connection address back to the USB default

app.btn_set.note: Button next to default phone app / call screening steps; means 'make it so'

app.check_priv_missing.back: Installed as an ordinary app (%1$s). Install the Bageo module in Magisk or KernelSU and restart. If you also installed the APK yourself, uninstall the self-installed one.
app.check_priv_missing.note: 'Flash the module' rendered as 'install the module' (everyday wording)

app.check_priv_title.back: Installed as a privileged system app

app.check_privperm_desc.back: The module grants these permissions at boot. They can't be granted from this page.

app.check_uplink_idle.back: Not seen yet. Some devices only show it during a call. If sending sound into the call fails, the app will alert you.
app.check_uplink_idle.note: Technical status text; original is jargon-heavy

app.check_uplink_missing.back: Module required: the MODIFY_PHONE_STATE permission is missing

app.check_uplink_ok.back: Found the phone call's audio channel.

app.check_uplink_title.back: Send AI voice into the call

app.confirm_ai_body.back: This phone will become the phone where the AI answers: calls will no longer ring, and the AI will pick up. Google Phone will be turned off and Do Not Disturb will be turned on.

app.confirm_normal_body.back: Calls will ring and you answer them yourself. The AI will no longer answer calls on this phone.

app.connection_hint_usb.back: USB (default, recommended): keep ws://127.0.0.1:8765. The program on the computer will automatically forward this port over the USB cable using adb reverse.

app.connection_hint_wifi.back: Wi-Fi: enter the address shown by the program on the computer, e.g. ws://192.0.2.10:8787/ws?token=… The phone and computer must be on the same network.

app.grant_perms.back: Allow the requested permissions, then tap Start service again.

app.header_compat.back: Tested on Pixel 7, 7a, 8 and 9. Other rooted phones may work; try at your own risk.

app.ip_code_hint.back: See it on the System page of the web control page

app.ip_err_busy.back: You entered the wrong code too many times. Wait a minute and try again.

app.ip_err_code.back: The pairing code is wrong or has expired. Get a new code on the web control panel.

app.ip_err_unreachable.back: Can't connect to this address. Make sure the phone and Bageo are on the same network.

app.ip_err_wifi_off.back: On the control panel, first turn on “Phones can also connect over Wi-Fi”.

app.mode_err_busy.back: The previous switch hasn't finished yet.

app.mode_err_dialer.back: Couldn't change the default phone app.

app.mode_err_dnd_mode.back: Do Not Disturb is still on. On the phone, open Settings → Modes and turn off “%1$s”.

app.mode_err_in_call.back: A call is in progress; hang up first.

app.mode_err_no_root.back: The Bageo module isn't running. In Magisk or KernelSU, check that the Bageo Uplink module is enabled, then restart the phone.

app.mode_err_screening.back: Couldn't change the call screening setting.

app.mode_failed.back: The switch didn't complete. %1$s You can try again.

app.mode_switch_hint.back: Turn off to use as a normal phone: calls ring and you answer yourself.

app.msg_no_browser.back: No app on this phone can open web pages.

app.msg_perm_settings.back: Some permissions can't be requested again here. Allow them in the app's system settings page.

app.msg_url_invalid.back: The address must start with ws:// or wss:// and include a host name.

app.msg_url_saved_pending.back: Saved. To use the new address, tap Stop service and then Start service when there is no call.

app.msg_url_saved_restarted.back: Saved. The service was restarted to use the new address.

app.msg_wifi_forgotten.back: Wi-Fi connection forgotten. Plug in the USB cable once to set it up again.

app.notification_text_armed.back: Ready. Waiting for calls; the phone stays silent.

app.notification_text_in_call.back: The AI is handling a call.

app.notification_text_normal.back: Normal phone: calls ring and you answer yourself.

app.perm_answer_calls.back: Answer calls: automatically answer and hang up

app.perm_modify_phone_state.back: Send AI voice into the call

app.perm_read_call_log.back: Call history: read the caller's number

app.perm_read_phone_state.back: Phone: know when a call starts and ends

app.route_custom.back: Connected to the address you entered.

app.st_ai_on.back: The AI is answering your calls

app.st_ai_on_d.back: Incoming calls are answered by the AI. The phone stays silent.

app.st_legacy_off.back: The old “AI answers” switch is off on this phone. Since this update, the switch at the top decides: now the AI answers calls here. Turn it off if you want to keep a normal phone.
app.st_legacy_off.note: Long migration notice; shortened wording kept faithful

app.st_normal.back: Normal phone: calls ring as usual

app.st_normal_d.back: The AI doesn't answer. You answer yourself, like on any phone. Turn on the switch below to have the AI answer again.

app.st_offline_d.back: Check that Bageo is running on the computer, and that the phone is plugged in via USB or on the same Wi-Fi (the first time, plug in USB to pair).

app.st_service_off_d.back: Tap Start to run it again.

app.st_steps_d.back: Finish the setup steps below so the AI can answer calls.

app.st_switching_d.back: Usually takes only a few seconds.

app.status_ok.note: Short status label next to a check mark

app.step_battery_desc.back: Keeps Android from closing Bageo to save battery, so you won't miss calls.

app.step_battery_title.back: Don't let the system put Bageo to sleep

app.step_dialer_desc.back: So the phone doesn't show the call screen while the AI is talking.

app.step_dialer_title.back: Set Bageo as the default phone app

app.step_dnd_desc.back: Keeps the phone quiet while the AI answers.

app.step_dnd_title.back: Allow Bageo to control Do Not Disturb

app.step_module_missing.back: Install the Bageo module in Magisk or KernelSU, then restart the phone.

app.step_pair_ip.back: Can't plug in USB (e.g. Bageo runs in Docker): get the pairing code on the web control panel, then tap “Connect by IP address”.

app.step_pair_missing.back: First time: turn on USB debugging and plug the phone into the computer running Bageo. After pairing once, the phone can also connect over Wi-Fi.

app.step_pair_ok.back: Paired with the computer. Calls still work over Wi-Fi when the cable is unplugged.

app.step_pair_title.back: Plug USB into the computer to pair

app.step_perms_desc.back: Needed to detect calls, answer them, and send the call audio to the computer.

app.step_perms_title.back: Allow Bageo to use the phone and microphone

app.step_screening_title.back: Set Bageo as the call screening app

app.test_fail_auth.back: rejected: the token in the address is missing or wrong

app.test_fail_network.back: can't connect to this address. Are the phone and computer on the same network?

app.test_fail_refused.back: the computer refused the connection. Is Bageo running there, and has the USB path been set up?

app.test_fail_rejected.back: something responded, but it isn't Bageo or it refuses the connection

app.uplink_missing_text.back: No call audio path. Make sure the Bageo module is installed and enabled, then restart.

app.uplink_missing_title.back: The caller can't hear the AI

app.wifi_not_ready.back: Wi-Fi backup isn't set up. Plug in the USB cable once to set it up.

app.wifi_ready.back: Wi-Fi backup is ready. Calls still work if you unplug the USB cable.

desktop.adb_failed.back: Download failed. Check your connection and try again.

desktop.adb_need.back: A phone plugged in via USB needs the Android tool (about 7 MB, from Google).

desktop.err_addr.back: The address must start with http:// or https://.

desktop.err_save.back: Some settings couldn't be saved. Try again.

desktop.locked.back: Enter the password to see your phones.

desktop.no_phone_hint.back: Plug in a phone and open the app. It will appear here.

desktop.r_launch_failed.back: Bageo couldn't start. See bageo.log in its folder.

desktop.r_offline.back: Can't connect to Bageo. Is it still running?

desktop.r_setup.back: {n} more items still need setting up

desktop.set_addr_hint.back: Leave blank to let it find itself.

desktop.set_notify_sms_old.back: Update Bageo and the message forwarding tool to get this notification.

desktop.set_notify_summary.back: When a call summary is available

desktop.set_pw_hint.back: Only needed if your control panel has a password.

console.hint_slack.back: Notifications: copy the incoming webhook link (works with Mattermost too) or fill in the bot token with the channel ID, either one. Chat commands (Slack only): turn on Socket mode then fill in the bot token (xoxb-), app-level token (xapp-) and channel ID
